steps.en: Officer indicates the number of stages for the reduction
steps.id: Officer menandai jumlah stage untuk reduction
steps.why_en: No screen or field in the system accepts a stage count.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar atau field di sistem yang menerima jumlah stage.

steps.en: The system computes the reduced amount from the stages
steps.id: Sistem menghitung jumlah reduction dari jumlah stage
steps.why_en: The amount is computed outside and the system only checks it.
steps.why_id: Jumlahnya dihitung di luar dan sistem hanya memeriksanya.

steps.en: The reduced amount is shown to the officer
steps.id: Jumlah setelah reduction ditampilkan ke officer
steps.why_en: The only reduced-amount field is commented out or not bound to data.
steps.why_id: Satu-satunya field jumlah reduction di-comment atau tidak terhubung ke data.

steps.en: Officer verifies and confirms the reduction
steps.why_en: Only the confirmed result is received from another system; no confirm screen here.
steps.why_id: Hanya hasil konfirmasi dari sistem lain yang diterima; tidak ada layar konfirmasi di sini.
